governedCriteria.observation: Both current Linux production captures for FsusUI 2.0.0 show the Scholarly Blue focus ring. The Avalonia perimeter probe matched all 192/192 samples.
Both current captures show the expected focus indicator without a default black adorner. The Avalonia perimeter probe found zero unexpected dark pixels.
Both current captures show the Check tag label in the unchecked appearance after real pointer and keyboard activation.
The recorded bounds agree before focus, after focus, and after toggle. Web bounds are 0,132,74.953125,24 CSS px. Avalonia bounds are 24,136,96,24 DIP.

limitations: Only the light/default/zh-CN/ltr/reduced-motion CheckTag checkpoint was independently accepted, not full CI, AOT, package, cross-platform rendering equivalence or performance.
Three recorded bounds checkpoints do not prove absence of intermediate-frame movement; cross-platform clocks were not synchronized.
AT-SPI and the Orca process are not spoken-output evidence. NVDA and VoiceOver were not tested. The Web CheckTag PNG is an element crop, not a visual inspection of the whole viewport.
